rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Do you remember the <color(5)>mobile weapons<ce()> that appeared at Saint Cruz?
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>A report came in moments ago: that unit has been located. It is at sea in the Cecilia Islands<thumbnail(161)>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>They are thought to be tied to the <color(5)>unidentified life-forms<ce()>. Their showing up in those waters can be no coincidence.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>In those waters lies a facility the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> developed in the past, called the "<book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>"<thumbnail(162)>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>It was being developed as a groundbreaking technology to achieve ultra-long-range space leaps.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>But... it was shut down 17 years ago, when it caused a large-scale runaway accident.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Newer technologies such as the <color(6)>Boson Jump<ce()> and fold had also taken its place, and so development was halted.
rows.notes: Boson Jump capitalised as in Encyclopedia; fold lowercase as in Encyclopedia Macross entry.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>And even its existence was erased from history... A thing with a dark past, so to speak.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>What this mysterious force is after there is not certain.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>But a distinctive energy signature<thumbnail(163)> is being detected from a facility that should be long abandoned.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>We need to investigate the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> and determine what it is that is happening now.

rows.notes: Source has no subject; impersonal construction kept.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Oh, yes. A <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces <book(19)>Dragoon<endbook()> unit will accompany this operation. I am counting on you!
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We will now begin the operation to capture the area around the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>If this operation goes well, I think the investigation will move forward too, so I am counting on you.

rows.notes: Ixbrau per unit_names_014_a (scene 4003020 still has older Exbrau).

rows.en: <operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>Refitting with these parts greatly boosts close-combat ability. On the other hand, shooting performance drops.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>Think carefully about what suits you when you choose.

uncertainties.issue: Cecilia Islands is unsourced (not in any glossary, no English source found); see glossary_proposals. Also "in the waters of / off" the islands: source says "on the sea of the Cecilia Islands".
Used Ixbrau (unit_names_014_a, brief) although released scene 4003020 and meeting_terms_015 still say Exbrau; one of them needs a script pass.
"refit parts" for kansou-you parts: no locked project term found for kansou (form change parts); check against the hangar/UI wording.
Seiatsu rendered "capture" to match the released mission title; "secure/suppress" would also be valid.

glossary_proposals.source: none found (searched web for ACE3 + Cecilia; superrobotwars.fandom.com/wiki/Another_Century%27s_Episode_3_THE_FINAL has no location names)
glossary_proposals.why: Game-original location of the Baldora Drive (mission 03). Standard romanisation of the katakana; provisional like Saint Cruz.
Ixbrau form-change parts; needs one project-wide term.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title equals missions_019 "03  Capture Baldora Drive".

Slot 20 ruling: "Cecilia Islands" is in no glossary file; plain romanisation of the katakana, kept as provisional - orchestrator should add it to the glossary. "at sea in the Cecilia Islands" is an acceptable reading of "Seshiria shotou no kaijou".
Slot 34 ruling: "Ixbrau" kept per orchestrator decision and unit_names_014_a. Released scene 4003020 slot 33 still prints "Exbrau" and needs the name-script pass.
Slot 34 ruling: "refit parts" - no locked term for "kansou" exists in any glossary or UI file (searched); the descriptive rendering is correct in meaning, kept.
Slot 32 ruling: "capture" kept - consistent with the mission title and meeting_briefing_015 "Capture all target bases".
Slot 31: "Dragoon" matches unit_names_014_a; "Federation" and "Boson Jump" match released usage.
Speakers: 30050 Kouichiro Misumaru, 30030 Ruri Hoshino, 30000 Faye Rochenante; Faye addresses Barrel (named in slot 34).
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 20: "Cecilia Islands" spelling has no English source; provisional.
Slot 34: "refit parts" has no project-wide term yet; if the hangar UI later names the form-change function differently, align this row and slot 35.
Slot 36: "what suits you" for "jibun no tekisei" (your own aptitude) is slightly loose; left.
